item.text:
I’m applying the frontend-design skill. The plan is slate blue `#26394f`, moon silver `#dce4ed`, amber `#d5aa62`, muted violet `#9486b7`, and transparent space. System serif type will identify the relic; system sans will carry status. A central faceted crystal gets the slow turn, approved runes occupy fixed orbit positions, and quiet concentric guide tracks remain visibly “0 growth rings.” Charge will report approved marks without implying travel or lineage.

I’ve kept the composition centered and left out dashboard cards and decorative labels so the relic itself carries the identity.

section='''## OBS idle overlay and public push

Use "'`/overlay/<configured-numeric-channel>` for the transparent OBS source; e.g. the local simulator uses `/overlay/111`. Add `?corner=1` for a 160px composition. Only `TWITCH_STREAMER_ID` is served; unknown channels/paths return 404. `/` remains the static Atlas and `/overlay` remains the honest legacy skeleton. No fake arrivals, travel history or ritual countdown was added.

The overlay has an original faceted silver/violet crystal with a slow turn, quiet concentric **guide tracks**, and an orbit of approved original rune images. Guide tracks are not lineage growth: the UI explicitly reports **0 growth rings; lineage not implemented**. Charge is the current approved mark count out of the bounded 160-mark capacity, not inferred travel or a claim of earned lineage. Slate blue, moon silver, amber and muted violet use system serif/sans typography, no downloaded fonts/assets. Reduced-motion preference stops the turn and charge transitions. The transparent canvas and corner layout have not yet been browser/OBS visually validated due to the launch blocker.

`GET /api/overlay/<channel>` returns a no-store public snapshot. `ws(s)://<same-origin>/ws/<channel>` sends an initial snapshot, then genuine server-pushed snapshots after committed store events/moderation/context changes. Public fields are limited to type, process-local revision, live/simulator mode, ready/waiting/paused/unavailable status, approved rune IDs/SVG, approved count, and zero lineage rings. Neither pending text/runes, raw user IDs, private quotas/cooldowns, OAuth state nor tokens are projected. Rune SVG is generated numeric geometry and displayed as image data URLs, never inserted as raw HTML. Missing trusted stream/Keeper context yields waiting/empty state; this lifecycle is still not wired and is never invented.

The feed serializes in-process commits, reads and publications; connection subscription is installed before its initial read, and both server/client reject older snapshot revisions. Revisions reset on process restart and each fresh connection resets its comparator. Forget/veto/block/opt-out removal is queued to connected clients immediately after commit; actual network delivery still has latency. Implemented `/overlay/:channel` with the original faceted relic, approved-rune orbit, truthful charge/zero lineage rings, transparent corner mode, reduced motion, and reconnect/stale handling.

Added safe snapshots, ordered WebSocket push after commits, privacy removals, resource controls, and a labelled local simulator. Declared `ws` 8.22.0, updated the offline lockfile, registered port 5191, and updated docs.

**Tests: 88 pass, 4 skipped, zero failures.** Loopback tests are blocked by `EPERM`; Chromium launch is also blocked, so no screenshot/browser proof is claimed.

Stream lifecycle and cross-instance fanout remain pending. No commits, cloud/live actions, secret reads, or servers left running.
